collection_method: Dynamic Trace Simulation Engine grounded in empirical ransomware kill-chain analysis from literature (Amer et al. 2026, Cen et al. 2025, Lin et al. 2025)
license: Defensive Research and Educational Use Only
safety_statement: All samples are fully synthetic behavioral traces representing Windows API calls. No destructive malware, real encryption payloads, or active exploits were executed or stored.

labels.0: benign (standard developer tools, compiler processes, office utilities, system diagnostics)
labels.1: suspicious (dual-use recon, process injection, persistence scripts, unencrypted network beacons)
labels.2: ransomware (full kill-chain: anti-debug, shadow copy deletion via vssadmin, cryptographic initialization, multi-threaded mass file encryption, and extortion note generation)

known_limitations: Synthetic behavior modeling simulates API invocation sequences and parameters without low-level kernel driver hooks (ETW/Sysmon kernel events) or external network packet captures.
